questions.stem: Carbon nanotubes are used to reinforce sports equipment such as tennis rackets. Why are they suitable for this?

options.text: They are very strong and lightweight
They conduct electricity, making the equipment safer
They are soft and flexible, providing comfort
They are cheap and easy to manufacture

questions.explanation: Carbon nanotubes are cylindrical fullerenes made of rolled graphene. They are approximately 100 times stronger than steel at the same weight, making them ideal for reinforcing materials. Their combination of extreme strength and light weight makes sports equipment stronger without adding significant mass.
